description: The chart illustrates three evaluation metrics for several sentence-embedding model variants from the referenced “2-Tier SimCSE” work, shown as grouped bars per model. The horizontal axis contains five categorical model settings in left-to-right order: “Single-task_baseline,” “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout,” “Unsupervised_SimCSE,” “Supervised_SimCSE,” and “2-Tier SimCSE.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy / Correlation” and uses a linear scale from 0 to about 0.9, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each category has three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend at the top: Sentiment Acc. (tan), STS Corr. (muted red), and Paraphrase Acc. (teal). For “Single-task_baseline,” the tan bar is about 0.53, the red bar about 0.50, and the teal bar about 0.79. For “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout,” the tan bar is about 0.52, the red bar about 0.58, and the teal bar about 0.78–0.79. For “Unsupervised_SimCSE,” the tan bar is about 0.52–0.53, the red bar about 0.72, and the teal bar about 0.77–0.78. For “Supervised_SimCSE,” the tan bar is about 0.49, the red bar about 0.80–0.81, and the teal bar about 0.78–0.79. For “2-Tier SimCSE,” the tan bar is about 0.49, the red bar about 0.81, and the teal bar about 0.78–0.79. The bars are grouped by model (not stacked), there is no explicit sorting beyond the displayed left-to-right category order, and no bars appear specially emphasized with outlines or annotations.
